usage.dispatch: clawdline remote dispatch --machine ID --pair ID --project ID --assistant NAME --title TITLE --instructions-file PATH [--task-id UUID --request-id UUID]
usage.send: clawdline remote send TASK-ID TEXT [--request-id UUID]
usage.finish: clawdline remote finish TASK-ID TEXT [--request-id UUID]
error.session: a current assistant Session is required
error.dispatch_fields: machine, pair, project, assistant, title and instructions file are required
error.retry_ids: task ID and request ID must be supplied together
error.instructions_size: instructions must be between 1 and 524288 bytes
error.effect_fields: task ID and text are required
dispatch_ids: task %s request %s; reuse both IDs if the reply is uncertain
event_id: request %s; reuse this ID if the reply is uncertain
